data.content_ref: inline:05a4074c795b reduces SRC_004's basin asymmetry to SRC_002's unbiased walk: the large basins are not static obstructions but the metastable plateau around rho*, so the probability of locking before consensus is exp(-Theta(sqrt n)) not 1-exp(-Theta(n)). Refuted if the basin measure of static local minima is comparable to the plateau measure, or if the descent reaches consensus with probability bounded away from 0.
